caption: The drawing features a large, central, white cross outlined in black, standing vertically and dividing the composition. The background is predominantly shades of peach and red, with a curtain-like design at the top, colored in deep red with black accents and outlined in black, draping down on either side of the cross. The upper corners of the drawing contain small, crossed shapes in dark brown. On either side of the cross, the curtain is gathered and accented with semi-circular and circular motifs. At the lower part of the drawing, both left and right sections are decorated with patterns of diagonal lines forming X-shapes and boxed areas filled with blue-grey squares, each bordered in red and black. Additional decorative black, red, and brown motifs such as swirls and heart-like shapes are present at the lower corners, and the vertical sides are bordered by columns that have a repeated zigzag or chevron pattern in black, white, and grey. The drawing is framed by a single black line near the edge and is executed entirely in watercolor or ink, with a harmonious palette of reds, peach, white, grey, blue, and black.
title: Plate 13: Design with Cross: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
